baseball_D1.notes: Equivalency sport. 2025-26 roster limit: 34 (House v. NCAA settlement) — not a scholarship count.

baseball_D2.notes: NCAA D2 equivalency limit, unaffected by the 2025 settlement.

baseball_D3.notes: NCAA D3 prohibits athletic scholarships — aid is need-based/academic only, any sport.

baseball_NAIA.notes: Secondary-sourced (2aDays), not cross-confirmed against a primary NAIA document — verify.

baseball_JUCO.notes: NJCAA publishes no numeric per-sport table; funding is by NJCAA division tier (D1 full-ride, D2 tuition/fees/books only, D3 none), not a fixed count.

softball_JUCO.notes: Tier-based (NJCAA D1 full/D2 partial/D3 none), no fixed per-sport count found.

basketball_D1.notes: Head-count sport. This app doesn't track athlete sex, so this uses the women's D1 figure (15) — men's D1 is 13. 2025-26 roster limit: 15 (both).

basketball_D2.notes: NCAA D2 equivalency limit — men's and women's are both 10.0, no ambiguity here.

basketball_NAIA.notes: Sources disagree (6-11 reported across sites for men's/women's) — low confidence, verify against a current NAIA compliance document.

basketball_JUCO.notes: Tier-based (NJCAA D1 full/D2 partial/D3 none), no fixed per-sport count found.

football_D1.notes: FBS head-count limit (85); FCS is equivalency, historically ~63 — schools.division has no FBS/FCS distinction. 2025-26 roster limit: 105 (both).

football_JUCO.notes: Tier-based (NJCAA D1 full/D2 partial/D3 none), no fixed per-sport count found.
